adjudications.justification: JSON路径simulated_k4_N12含'simulated'前缀,表明为模拟中间量(k=4,N=12)。论文报告的两个Friedman检验(16任务p=0.3679;6任务p=0.0026)在样本量与p值上均不匹配；df=3(k=4)也不符论文3模型设定。机械层三候选无法对应任一已报告值。
adjudications.evidence: Cross-model Friedman on 16 paired tasks was non-significant ($p=0.3679$); curated L1a (6 tasks, exploratory) gives $p=0.0026$, still significant after Holm correction ($p=0.0261$).
adjudications.suggested_action: 无需补报；确认simulated_k4_N12为内部模拟中间量,与论文实际Friedman检验无关,可从可复算性检查中排除。
